answer: Renewal increases for rent stabilized apartments are set each year by the Rent Guidelines Board. For a one-year lease commencing on or after October 1, 2025 and on or before September 30, 2026, NYC Rent Guidelines Board 2025 Apartment & Loft Order #57 applies to your lease start date. Although you have confirmed your stabilization status, the assistant cannot state a specific renewal increase percentage or dollar amount as a promise for your own apartment because renewal increases depend on your lease term selection and the applicable order. You should confirm your stabilization status with DHCR before relying on any figure.
